notes.title: Store page overhaul coming soon!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

A lot of work has been done on Ignifugo, and the store page will receive a major overhaul next month. This post serves as a sneak peak on what will change soon.

Coming changes:
- Completely new trailer which better shows off core features (especially the shell creation)
- Better and more descriptive screenshots
- Improved descriptions
- Updated tags
- Updated social links

Visit the Real Crab Games Discord to get development updates and talk about the game.

I really look forward to showing you the new store page and especially to your feedback!

Have a great day,

Fabi / Real Crab Games
